card.name: Linking words before vaccine names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, for, a comma) or the end of 'pneumococcal'/'meningococcal' right before a vaccine name, in drug-label vaccine and immune-response sections.

modes.label: Inside bacterial vaccine names
modes.description: The ending 'cal' of pneumococcal or meningococcal, just before polysaccharide or vaccines.

modes.label: Link word before a vaccine
modes.description: A word like to, with or for after 'antibody response' or 'up to date' and before the vaccine.
modes.example: not up to date<< with>> meningococcal vaccines according to AC

card.writes: It pushes toward continuing with vaccine-related terms and away from words like recognition and awareness.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or word ending just ahead of a vaccine name in label text about vaccines and immune response.
